work.projectDescription: NO TOMORROW is a short cinematic 3D story about a young boy who discovers that a meteor will destroy the world tomorrow. He spends his final day with his family before facing an uncertain future. I will build the game independently using Unity and C#. The project will include a playable main character, character movement, a 3D environment, simple interactions, cinematic camera movements, and a dramatic ending. My goal is to create a short but emotional gaming experience that tells a complete story through visuals and gameplay.
work.gitEvidence: I opened my Unity project in Visual Studio, reviewed my C# scripts, and made changes to my project. I saved my work and used Git to commit and push my changes to my GitHub repository. I then opened GitHub to verify that my latest files and commit were uploaded successfully.
work.aiVerify: i will run and inspect the codes down to every detail
work.notes: I can contribute by creating characters, writing C# scripts, designing simple game mechanics, testing gameplay, and troubleshooting errors. I can use Unity and Visual Studio to build and improve projects. I am continuing to develop my programming skills and can use AI tools to help solve problems and understand code.
work.plan: I chose a playable story because I want to create an emotional cinematic gaming experience. I will use Unity and C# because they allow me to build 3D environments, character movement, animations, and interactions. My production sequence will follow planning, gathering resources, building, testing, backing up with GitHub, and delivering the final game.

huddle.goal: Create a playable 3D scene in Unity where a young boy can move through an environment, interact with his surroundings, and experience the beginning of a cinematic story about an approaching meteor.
huddle.personal: As the solo developer, I will be responsible for designing the game, creating characters and environments, programming gameplay mechanics, testing the project, and fixing errors. I understand the production pipeline as a series of steps that take my original idea and turn it into a completed playable game. I will use ChatGPT to help me understand code and troubleshoot problems while developing my skills in Unity and C#.
huddle.questions: Some challenges I may face include character movement, animations, camera controls, scripting errors, and creating cinematic scenes. I will test the gameplay regularly, check that all interactions work correctly, and use GitHub to back up my progress. I also need to make sure the final game runs smoothly and communicates the story clearly.

dailyDraft.blocker: I need some assistance connecting my Unity project to GitHub and organizing my project files correctly. I am also continuing to learn Unity and C# so I can build my characters, scenes, and gameplay mechanics.
